Course.title: Course
Course.description: An academic course enrolled by the student.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student.

code.description: Short course code such as CS 301.

colorHex.description: Hex color token for visual grouping.

StudyItem.title: StudyItem
StudyItem.description: A homework assignment or scheduled exam with deadline reminders and optional Google Calendar sync metadata.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student.

description.description: Notes, syllabus chapters, or submission instructions.

courseColorHex.description: Hex color associated with the course.

location.description: Exam hall, classroom, or online submission portal.

dueAtMillis.description: Due timestamp or exam start time in UTC milliseconds.

durationMinutes.description: Duration in minutes for calendar event blocks.

reminderMinutesBefore.description: Minutes before dueAtMillis to fire a push notification.

notifyEnabled.description: Whether push notification reminders are active for this item.

googleCalendarEventId.description: Google Calendar v3 event ID once synced, or empty string if unsynced.

calendarSyncedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of last successful Google Calendar sync (0 if unsynced).

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user notification and Google Calendar sync preferences.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student.

pushNotificationsEnabled.description: Master switch for deadline push notifications.

defaultHomeworkReminderMinutes.description: Default lead time in minutes for homework alerts.

defaultExamReminderMinutes.description: Default lead time in minutes for exam alerts.

dailyDigestEnabled.description: Whether to deliver a daily study digest notification.

dailyDigestHour.description: Hour of day (0-23) for the daily digest.

googleCalendarAutoSync.description: Whether changes automatically sync to Google Calendar when authorized.

lastCalendarSyncMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last full Google Calendar sync.

currentStreakDays.description: Active consecutive daily study streak count.

lastActiveDayKey.description: Most recent local date key (yyyy-MM-dd) counted toward the study streak.

recentStreakDaysCsv.description: Comma-separated recent active date keys (yyyy-MM-dd) for weekly streak display.

themeMode.description: Appearance mode: suggested (auto), manual light, or manual dark.

themePalette.description: Suggested theme preset or manual custom accent theme.

manualAccentHex.description: Hex color chosen when manual theme customization is active.

studentName.description: Student's preferred display name for their profile.

studentMajor.description: Student's major, track, or program of study.

studentYear.description: Academic year or grade level (e.g., Junior, 11th Grade).

studentIdLabel.description: Optional student ID or graduation cohort label.

studentBio.description: Student bio, interests, and study focus.

SubjectGrade.title: SubjectGrade
SubjectGrade.description: A student's recorded numeric and letter grade for a subject or course.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student.

subjectCode.description: Optional short course code such as CS 301.

assessmentTitle.description: Optional assessment label such as Midterm or Term Grade.

letterGrade.description: Letter grade such as A, A-, B+, B, or custom label.

courseColorHex.description: Hex color token for visual grouping.

gradedAtMillis.description: Timestamp in UTC milliseconds when the grade was recorded.

/users/{userId}/study_items/{itemId}.description: Student's homework assignments and exam schedules.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Student's notification and Google Calendar sync settings.

/users/{userId}/grades/{gradeId}.description: Student's recorded numeric and letter grades per subject.
